_note: Working values taken from the live ISTE site, not from an official brand guide. Replace with official values when the brand team supplies them.
name: ISTE+ASCD
fullName: International Society for Technology in Education (ISTE), merged with ASCD

accent.role: Accent. Links, buttons, one focal element per view. Never a large fill.

gray.role: Body copy, captions, secondary text. Never pure black.

logoColorsSampled._note: Pixel-sampled from the logo files in public/logos. Close, not official.

typography.approach: Clean sans-serif, bold headings, generous spacing. No serif, script, condensed or tight letter-spacing.
typography.officialTypeface: TBD from brand team (check web licence)

voice: Inspirational yet professional. Speaks to educators as peers. Aspirational words (transform, spark, thrive) backed by pedagogical credibility. No empty hype or heavy jargon.
imagery: Authentic, diverse students and educators engaged with technology in real classrooms. Flat or line icons. Abstract network motifs, not clip art.
